rules.title: Clock-domain inventory and sequential elements without an identified clock root
rules.notes: report unclassified flops

rules.title: Clock root that is not a primary input (logic-generated, gated through a black box, cyclic or undriven)

rules.title: Asynchronous multi-bit crossing without recognized safe protocol
rules.notes: primary error

rules.title: Combinational logic between synchronizer stages
rules.notes: connectivity path check

rules.title: Non-final synchroniser stage feeds anything but the next stage
rules.notes: absorbs CDC-027

rules.title: Combinational, glitch-prone or unregistered source before synchronizer
rules.notes: heuristic; source stability assumed unless specified

rules.title: Individually synchronized bus bits / incoherent capture
rules.notes: avoid blanket exemption for 2FF-per-bit

rules.title: Destination cone combines two or more asynchronous influences
rules.notes: absorbs CDC-011 and CDC-036; evidence: reconvergence_kind same-domain | multi-domain | unsynchronised

rules.title: Missing/incorrect synchronization attributes or recognized primitive metadata
rules.notes: technology profile dependent
rules.gap: checks RTL synchronizer attributes only; recognized primitive metadata and technology profile bundles are not checked

rules.title: Pulse may be shorter than the destination capture window
rules.notes: absorbs CDC-042 (computed event-like signals); rates known or unknown

rules.title: Toggle/event-transfer synchronizer malformed
rules.notes: structural template

rules.title: Handshake request/acknowledge structural mismatch
rules.notes: structural only; NOT protocol proof

rules.title: Unguarded multi-bit payload crossing despite synchronised control
rules.notes: structural data-hold policy

rules.title: Async FIFO Gray pointer sync chain or pointer crossing issue
rules.notes: recognized FIFO pattern

rules.title: Gray-code multi-bit crossing without trustworthy source stability/skew constraints
rules.notes: structural check, not proof of Gray transitions

rules.title: Clock multiplexer or combiner not recognised as glitch-free
rules.notes: library/model-specific

rules.title: Clock-gate enable launched in another clock domain
rules.notes: split: gating without an enable latch is CDC-045; black-box gating is CDC-002

rules.title: Register captures a value that may be driven by an unmodelled black box
rules.notes: report as unresolved unless modeled

rules.title: Protocol functional-correctness obligation for a recognised FIFO, handshake or toggle structure
rules.notes: Analyze protocol structure and emit explicit proof obligations; classify as proven only with sufficient evidence. No claim that heuristic pattern matching proves arbitrary protocol correctness.

rules.title: Reset-source inventory and registers without an identified reset root
rules.notes: required foundation

rules.title: Reset input with no constraint (unknown reset source)
rules.notes: incomplete coverage

rules.title: Asynchronous reset deassertion not synchronized to receiving clock
rules.notes: handle exceptions explicitly

rules.title: Data crosses between different reset domains on the same clock
rules.notes: central RDC use case

rules.title: Data crosses between independently reset domains on different clocks
rules.notes: classify overlap with CDC

rules.title: Reset synchronizer has too few stages or logic between stages
rules.notes: recognize patterns and assumptions

rules.title: Reset generated by a register or logic in another clock/reset domain
rules.notes: async assertion vs deassertion

rules.title: Reset net combined from two or more reset sources
rules.notes: graph-based

rules.title: Reset gating/muxing that may glitch
rules.notes: physical glitch proof excluded

rules.title: Unreset register feeding a reset register of the same module instance
rules.notes: context-aware heuristic

rules.title: Several independent asynchronous reset sources: sequencing not modelled
rules.notes: explicit incomplete status, not presumed safe

rules.title: Power intent not supplied: retention and isolation resets are not evaluated
rules.notes: Power-intent-related reset crossing analysis when power-domain information is supplied; label missing power intent unknown rather than safe.

rules.title: Recovery, removal and minimum pulse width obligation for every asynchronous reset
rules.notes: Report recovery/removal/pulse-width proof obligations; physical safety needs library/timing data, so absence of that information is not evidence of safety.

rules.title: Every register has an identified clock and reset classification (including explicit `no_reset`)
rules.gap: reset classification from event lists and a heuristic synchronous-reset pattern; explicit user-declared no_reset is not supported yet

rules.title: All named constraint paths resolve to actual design objects
rules.gap: only create_clock source objects are resolved

rules.title: No conflicting clock relationships or contradictory exceptions
Crossings with unknown relationship are flagged as `unresolved`, not `safe`
rules.gap: relationship derived from SDC clock names and set_clock_groups only; generated-clock and exception semantics are not applied

rules.title: All blackbox instances are inventoried and marked modeled/unmodeled
rules.gap: only modules that slang reports as unknown are inventoried; encrypted/blackbox-attributed modules are not distinguished

rules.title: Waivers have narrow matching criteria, reason, owner and optional expiry
Every recognized synchronizer/CDC primitive has an explicit, documented trust model
Timing-cut and false-path exceptions do not imply CDC safety
SDC subset support and unsupported Tcl commands are disclosed
Unsupported constructs or bit-precision fallbacks are tracked in coverage report
rules.gap: records only the fallbacks produced by the connectivity/clock/reset model and in-source slang pragmas; constructs the model ignores without a fallback (classes, tasks, initial blocks, primitives) are not enumerated

rules.title: Illegal or unsafe assignment to net / variable kind
rules.notes: Respect SV procedural/continuous assignment legality and deliberate tri-state usage.

rules.title: Duplicate or overlapping case arms
rules.notes: Check constant overlap, wildcard ambiguity and priority selection.

rules.title: Suspicious `unique`, `unique0`, `priority` claims
rules.notes: Check syntactic semantics and report violations that are statically decidable.

rules.title: Conditional expression width/sign ambiguity
rules.notes: Detect incompatible branch types and unintended coercions.

rules.title: Shifted or unsized operand widened by its context, and out-of-range shift counts
rules.notes: slang shift-count-overflow/-negative, signed-logical-shift, unsigned-arith-shift

rules.title: Product narrower than its operands, or carry lost by a self-determined addition
rules.notes: Check expression context width, signed extension, multiplication and shifts.

rules.title: Divide or modulo by zero where statically provable
rules.notes: Distinguish constant proof from variable-divisor uncertainty.

rules.title: Comparison with itself or with a constant outside the operand range, and contradictory or tautological boolean pairs (a && !a, a || !a)
rules.notes: Detect always true/false comparators and misleading Boolean reductions.

rules.title: Unintentional X/Z assignments in synthesizable RTL
rules.notes: Configurable 4-state and synthesis-intent policy; do not blanket ban tri-state.

rules.title: X/Z literals in comparisons, case items, inside sets and conditions; ===/!==
rules.notes: Flag known case/if/conditional simulation-vs-hardware hazards with evidence.

rules.title: Incomplete array, struct, union or interface assignments
rules.notes: Range/field-specific driver and read-before-write coverage.

rules.title: Partial or overlapping output drive through hierarchy
rules.notes: Recognize bit ranges and dynamically indexed writes conservatively.

rules.title: Sequential variable read before intended assignment
rules.notes: Use reaching-definitions for local temporaries and procedural flow.

rules.title: Combinational sensitivity mismatch in legacy `always`
rules.notes: Distinguish `always_comb` semantics from explicit/manual sensitivity.

rules.title: Data-driven clock, asynchronous control or event expressions (inferred gated clocks)
rules.notes: Detect inappropriate variable-triggered event control in synthesizable modules.

rules.title: ASIC versus FPGA initialization assumptions
rules.notes: Require profile-aware assumptions about `initial`, RAM and FF init.

rules.title: Suspicious inferred RAM or mixed memory access semantics
rules.notes: Find multiple writes, asynchronous read assumptions and unsupported inference.

rules.title: Input/output port direction or interface modport misuse
rules.notes: Check illegal use and unexpected integration-level drive orientation.

rules.title: Unreachable generate alternatives for selected configuration
rules.notes: Document and analyze each manifest-selected parameter configuration.

rules.title: Write overwritten before any read
rules.notes: Flow-sensitive dead-store / conflicting-assignment analysis.

rules.title: Register with neither reset nor initial value read in a condition
rules.notes: Analyze reset/initialization reachability conservatively.

rules.title: Unsigned difference compared below zero
rules.notes: counter-guard and decrement forms are LNT-038 (comparison with a constant outside the operand range)

rules.title: Constant concatenation or replication whose width differs from its assignment target
rules.notes: Elaboration-aware packed-width accounting.

rules.title: Parameter-dependent truncation at an assignment or port connection
rules.notes: Check hierarchical port/call edges and parameter variation.
rules.gap: only direct parameter references in the declared dimension are recognised; widths declared through a typedef or a nested type are not classified

rules.title: Asynchronous control polarity does not match its edge
rules.notes: split: not-tested is LNT-069, non-constant reset value is LNT-070

rules.title: Unused package imports / declarations and shadowing
rules.notes: Separate elaboration-only references from runtime dependencies.

rules.title: Blocking write in a clocked process read by another process
rules.notes: Conservative scheduler/race-pattern lint, not a simulation substitute.
rules.gap: reads and writes inside the bodies of user subroutines are not followed

rules.title: Dependency on non-synthesizable system tasks/functions
rules.notes: Recognize synthesizable profile exceptions and testbench code.

rules.title: Nonblocking assignment in a combinational block
rules.notes: split from LNT-015

rules.title: One variable assigned with both blocking and nonblocking assignments
rules.notes: split from LNT-015

rules.title: casez or casex item whose bits are all wildcards
rules.notes: split from LNT-016

rules.title: Case statement without default or with uncovered values
rules.notes: split from LNT-016; slang case-default/case-incomplete/case-none diagnostics

rules.title: X or Z constant that reaches the condition of an assignment (flow-insensitive)
rules.notes: only exact constant moves (assign x = 1'bx, q <= constant, reset values) are followed; constants behind ?:, concatenations with logic or wide expressions are not, hence Heuristic

rules.title: Register without a reset value (assigned only outside the reset branch)
rules.notes: split from LNT-020

rules.title: always_ff block without reset in a module whose other always_ff blocks reset
rules.notes: split from LNT-020

rules.title: Edge control not tested by the first if / else-if chain (clock-like or untested asynchronous control)
rules.notes: absorbs LNT-022 clause 2 and LNT-058 clauses (b) and 3+ controls

rules.title: Reset branch of an asynchronous reset assigns a non-constant value
rules.notes: split from LNT-058

rules.title: FSM reachability and liveness obligation (proof not attempted)
rules.notes: split from LNT-029; INFO obligation per enum FSM, never a proof

rules.title: Reset net feeding the logic that generates a clock
rules.notes: split from LNT-027

rules.title: Constant assigned to a narrower target changes its value
rules.notes: split from LNT-026

rules.title: Unsized literal compared with an operand wider than 32 bits
rules.notes: split from LNT-026

rules.title: Missing explicit `default_nettype none` before a declaration
rules.notes: Moved from STY-006
rules.gap: checks that each module, interface and program is preceded in its own source file by `default_nettype none`; a directive written in an `include`d file or given on the command line is not recognised, library units (-v/-y) are not checked, and the implicit-net policy (use of implicit nets inside the design) is not checked

rules.title: Plain always procedure
rules.notes: Moved from STY-007
rules.gap: flags every plain 'always' block in user sources and suggests a replacement from its sensitivity list; library units (-v/-y) are not checked, misuse of always_comb/always_ff/always_latch is not checked (a separate semantic concern), and an always_latch choice for an intentional latch needs review

rules.title: Synchronizer stage clock/reset mismatch
rules.notes: All required stages must belong to compatible destination and reset domains.

rules.title: Clock-enable based unsafe data crossing
rules.notes: Model clock enable qualification rather than treating it as synchronization.

rules.title: Asynchronous top-level input without CDC contract
rules.notes: Distinguish externally clocked input and asynchronous controls.

rules.title: create_generated_clock relationship assumed by constraints, not derived from the design
rules.notes: Avoid classifying frequency-related clocks as safely synchronous without constraints.

rules.title: Clock multiplexer select not synchronous to the clocks it switches
rules.notes: Model known glitchless primitives; report unknown topology and dynamic select.

rules.title: Data/control bundle coherence after synchronization
rules.notes: Check data-valid, request/payload and qualifier associations.

rules.title: Gray pointer pair with a pointer register that has no asynchronous reset
rules.notes: reset release coordination between the two sides is RDC-023

rules.title: Memory written and read in different clock domains
rules.notes: unpacked-array memories and library ram cells

rules.title: Clock group relationship contradiction with observed synchronizers
rules.notes: Flag misleading group constraints and missing related clocks.

rules.title: Multi-cycle/falsely cut paths do not establish CDC safety
rules.notes: Track timing exceptions independently of synchronization evidence.

rules.title: Payload qualification and data-stability obligations
rules.notes: Recognize Gray/bundle exemptions only with required attributes/constraints.

rules.title: Synchroniser recognised from an annotation or a library description
rules.notes: Report missing or contradictory library annotations.

rules.title: Reset-dependent CDC protocol activation / release
rules.notes: Classify crossings under reset-active and reset-release conditions.

rules.title: Mixed positive/negative edge domains
rules.notes: Model edge relationship and relevant metastability boundaries.

rules.title: Asynchronous serial/event stream crossing assumptions
rules.notes: Differentiate event pulses from stable level handshakes.

rules.title: Clock gated by logic without a recognised enable latch
rules.notes: split from CDC-020; library clock_gate cells declare enable_latched

rules.title: Black-box input fed from another clock domain
rules.notes: split from CDC-023; library blackbox cells declare port directions and clock roles

rules.title: Asynchronous reset driven by a data register that is not a reset synchroniser
rules.notes: Report structural hazards plus proof obligations requiring timing information.

rules.title: Reset synchronizer stage fanout to logic
rules.notes: Identify use of intermediate reset synchronizer stages.

rules.title: Reset mux/gate select from different reset domain
rules.notes: Follow asynchronously changing select controls and reset outputs.

rules.title: Asynchronous reset signal also used as functional data
rules.notes: Differentiate reset semantics from general clock crossing.

rules.title: Partial reset of packed state and dependent control
rules.notes: Find unstable unreset bits influencing reset-visible behavior.

rules.title: FIFO and handshake reset release sequencing
rules.notes: Check reset-domain coordination / unknown protocol obligations.

rules.title: Reset request/acknowledge sequencing across domains
rules.notes: Static recognition and explicit unresolved functional obligations.

rules.title: Primary output that depends on a register without reset
rules.notes: Detect uncontrolled outputs and reset isolation assumptions.

rules.title: Several asynchronous controls on one register (set and reset, power-on and functional)
rules.notes: Check priority and behavior if both assert/deassert independently.

rules.title: Reset-domain false-path exception does not imply safety
rules.notes: Record RDC crossing despite timing cuts.

rules.title: One reset used with both polarities, or a reset that is the inverted copy of its source
rules.notes: Validate propagated reset aliases, inversions, and synchronizer output use.

rules.title: Retention or isolation reset boundaries when power intent provided
rules.notes: Handle active power intents and missing modeling explicitly.
rules.gap: needs a power-intent (UPF/CPF) input, which is not supported; RDC-012 reports the missing model

rules.title: Source-clock constraint coverage of all sequential endpoints
rules.notes: All clocks including generated/muxed roots covered or unresolved.
rules.gap: clock constraints only; reset and I/O constraint coverage not evaluated

rules.title: Top-level IO and abstract IP CDC contracts
rules.gap: Input-side and abstract-IP CDC contracts are not checked; output-boundary contracts only.
rules.notes: Document synchronized/related/asynchronous IO assumptions.

rules.title: Generated clock divider/multiplier/phase consistency
rules.notes: Compare declared relations to RTL derivation where discernible.

rules.title: Dynamic modes and mutually exclusive clock configurations
rules.gap: Cross-mode validation and mutually exclusive clock configuration validation are not implemented.
rules.notes: Discloses applied case constants and unanalysed alternatives.

rules.title: Multi-configuration parameter/generate completeness
rules.notes: Coverage matrix across representative compile manifests.

rules.title: Reset-state and reset-sequence assumptions are explicit
rules.notes: Classify unmodeled reset phase conditions as unresolved.

rules.title: Blackbox boundary protocol and reset metadata quality
rules.notes: Track missing blackbox contract, model scope and location.

rules.title: Constraint parser completeness with unsupported directives
rules.notes: Source report every skipped unsupported directive or expression.
rules.gap: parse problems and unreadable files only; semantic validation of option values is limited

rules.title: Rule/profile enablement coverage and policy drift
rules.notes: All registered checks accounted for by active profile and exceptions.
rules.gap: accounts for rules not fully evaluated and for unknown rule names; profile policy drift is not checked

rules.title: Crossing inventory consistency and report completeness
rules.notes: Every crossing classified unsafe, safe-with-evidence, waived or unresolved.

rules.title: Constraint source provenance and conflict trace
rules.notes: Provide file/line and origin of all clock/reset classifications.

rules.title: Waiver expiration, stale match and overbroad-waiver warning
rules.notes: Prevent a waiver from masking new unrelated issues.

rules.title: Selective blackbox and encrypted RTL coverage reporting
rules.notes: Disclosure of unresolved analysis depth, not silent clean.

rules.title: Physical-assumption proof obligation inventory
rules.notes: Mark MTBF, recovery/removal and implementation-dependent checks needing external data.
